facts.frame: LCG071-PRO gravel frameset with integrated HBR08 cockpit and downtube storage
facts.frame_construction: 3D latex-mandrel monocoque with full internal routing
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-52 frame including the downtube lid; 1,110–1,200 g across four sizes, ±40 g; fork 495 g ±15 g
facts.cockpit: HBR08 integrated carbon bar/stem; 380–440 mm bars and 90–120 mm stems
facts.storage: Downtube compartment for two optional 200 ml bags; lid retains bottle-cage mounts
facts.geometry: Reach 374.1–397.1 mm; stack 542.6–627.1 mm; 430 mm chainstays; 70 mm BB drop; 62.7–69.3 mm trail
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer attributes a 30% strength improvement to its molding process, without an independent protocol or exact-model stiffness result
facts.chainring compatibility: Manufacturer maxima: Shimano 2x 54–40T / 1x 42T; SRAM 2x 54–41T / 1x 42T. Confirm exact crank and chainline before assembly.
facts.groupset compatibility: Manufacturer supports mechanical and Di2, but explicitly excludes older rear derailleurs without B-LINK, including Shimano 105 5800.
